theorem final_wf : ¬ (∀ (p : ℕ), p > 2 ∧ ¬ (p % 2 = 0) → p is_prime ∧ 91 is_prime) := by sorry
theorem final_pos : ¬ (∀ (p : ℕ), p > 2 ∧ ¬ (p % 2 = 0) → p is_prime ∧ 91 is_prime) := by fv_auto
theorem final_neg : ¬ (¬ (∀ (p : ℕ), p > 2 ∧ ¬ (p % 2 = 0) → p is_prime ∧ 91 is_prime)) := by fv_auto
